memory.metric: Same-sample process RssAnon + fdinfo allocation sizes deduplicated by (mnt_id, ino)
memory.scope: Child process before exec through exit, including model loading
memory.aggregation: Maximum sampled composite over all three repeats
limitations: Not total physical device peak: private DSP heap, driver and VTCM allocations may be absent.
Allocated fd sizes are not necessarily resident bytes; do not add RSS, VmHWM or arena size.
Sequential procfs scans may race fd changes and miss short-lived peaks.
All selected peak samples have complete identity/dedup fields and no fd read errors. Other samples can have close races.
